dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: Greetings, guest from afar! If you're looking for Qiaoying Village, just keep walking north on this road.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: I'm Moyan, the village accountant. I sometimes also help the others with odd jobs here and there.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: Our merchants often pass through here, and I ask after their businesses every day.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: I also visit every family in the village every month, so I have a good idea of how we're doing financially.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Qiaoying Village...

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: We're already within Qiaoying Village's borders. Welcome to the home of Liyue's most famous tea!

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: Qiaoying Village is not as bustling as Yilong Wharf, but a quieter, more relaxed place has value all its own.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: If you like tea, please give our Sunglo Tea and Single-Origin Yauwan Tea a try. You'll love them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: Please take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds really tough...

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: Thank you for asking!

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: My job's not that difficult, especially when compared to taking care of tea trees, drying tea, and stirring them in a hot pan. After all, tea is our most important commodity.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: The tea farmers get up while it's still dark and work year-round to make sure that people everywhere get to enjoy it at a fair price.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: I've never heard them complaining about their work, either.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: They love tea, and they make the most out of their days. That must have rubbed off on me, I guess, 'cause I'm pretty proactive myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are things lately?

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: It's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: For some reason, the first harvest this year is yellower than usual, and didn't fetch a good price.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: Most of the villagers live off of the money we make growing tea, so we need to figure out what happened as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your income...

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: It's not all stormy clouds. The first harvest wasn't great, but the second was better.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: When you grow things, you're bound to have a bad year here and there. I just hope next year will be better.
